role: Push/PR-triggered Linux workflow ("Gates") running the subset of `make ci` gates that need no Xcode, SwiftLint, plutil or simulator — the only CI that runs automatically.
toplevel: Triggers: push to main, pull_request (all), workflow_dispatch. One job script-gates. Explicitly excluded (by header comment): lint, lint-budget, verify-gates (SwiftLint), test-coverage and thread-sanitizer (Xcode). Also absent without being listed: release-build. The gate list is a hand-copied subset of Makefile `ci`; the header says check_gates_wired.sh audits it (every gate must run here unless NOT_ON_PUSH says why). Budget ratchet baseline: PR target, else the tip before the push (github.event.before), else HEAD~1, always with BUDGET_REQUIRE_BASELINE=1.

units.does: ubuntu-latest job "Script gates (no Xcode)" (timeout 15): runs the Makefile gates that need only bash/python/git, the code-map check (records current, re-checks; the open-findings ratchet does not run here, its overlay being local only), on pull requests the code-map impact report to the job summary, then the budget ratchet. Required to pass before anything merges to main.

units.does: Runs `make codemap-setup` and then scripts/check_codemap.sh with the venv interpreter on the Linux runner, so every push to main and every pull request fails while any code-map record is missing, empty or stale; re-check lines are counted without failing. The open-findings ratchet does not run here: its overlay (do_not_ship/codemap) is local only.

units.key: step script-gates/Code map impact of this pull request
units.does: On pull requests only, and even when an earlier step failed (unless the run was cancelled): runs make codemap-setup (a no-op when the venv already works) and then `codemap.py impact --base origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF` with the venv interpreter, which writes the impact list for the PR's changes (callers up to triggers, tests, docs, shared state; no findings, since the overlay is local only) to the job summary. Not a gate: it exits 0 whenever the base ref resolves. Setting up its own interpreter keeps it working when an earlier step failed and the code map check never created the venv.

units.key: step script-gates/Debt budgets ratchet down only
units.does: Budget ratchet, always with BUDGET_REQUIRE_BASELINE=1 so a baseline that does not resolve fails the step. On a pull_request compares against origin/$GITHUB_BASE_REF. On a push compares against the tip before the push (github.event.before, passed as PUSH_BEFORE) when it is set, not the null SHA, and resolves to a commit in the checkout, so every commit of a multi-commit push is inside the compared range and the budget-raise-ok trailer scan. Otherwise (dispatch, or a created/forced push whose before-commit is absent) compares against HEAD~1, printing a note when a push's before-commit was unusable; on a root commit prints a message and passes.
